items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: Gilbert Young used to always tell him, man, you don't play no trombone like that.

ctx.x: And we used to first one started playing solos on trombone. Lead. Gilbert Young used to always tell him, man, you don't play no trombone like that. Play a trombone vamp, you know? They used to vamp a trombone, you know? We used to first one started playing, uh, solos. Yeah, Jack's trying to have a lot of solos on brach. We used to first one started that. Before Tommy Dawson was thought of playing solos, you know? But Tommy Dawson get, uh, the praise, cause he's the first one started to the public. Yeah. But we…
Palace Theatre. What band was he playing with at the time? Do you remember that?
